name: ALEPH-2
summary: A very rare Phenethylamine, also known as DOT-2, it is the DOx analogue of 2C-T-2. There is very little human use reported. Described as being quite long and highly visual. The drug is suspected to be potent, with a reported threshold dose of 3mg.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Aleph-2 acts as a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist

uses.text: The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Europe in 2023.

summaryZh: 阿列夫-2是一種含氮有機硫化合物，分子式C13H21NO2S，屬於2,5-二甲氧基安非他命衍生物（DOx系列化合物）。

sideEffects.en: Very little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of its family, the DOx amphetamines, tend to be long lasting and can cause anxiety, confusion, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, and difficult experiences.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響幾乎沒有資料。同家族的 DOx 類安非他命迷幻藥作用時間通常很長，可能引起焦慮、混亂、心跳與血壓上升，以及難受的經驗。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响几乎没有数据。同家族的 DOx 类安非他命迷幻药作用时间通常很长，可能引起焦虑、混乱、心跳与血压上升，以及难受的经验。

fact.en: Aleph is the first letter of the Hebrew alphabet. Alexander Shulgin used it to name this series of sulphur-containing amphetamines in his 1991 book PiHKAL.
fact.zh: Aleph 是希伯來字母的第一個字母。Alexander Shulgin 在 1991 年的著作《PiHKAL》中，以它為這一系列含硫安非他命命名。
fact.zhHans: Aleph 是希伯来字母的第一个字母。Alexander Shulgin 在 1991 年的著作《PiHKAL》中，以它为这一系列含硫安非他命命名。
